What is the difference between a list and a tuple?

Supplied answer
A list is mutable, written with [], and has many methods (append, remove, sort). A tuple is immutable,
written with (), and has only count() and index(). Tuples are slightly faster and use less memory, and
because they are immutable they can be used as dictionary keys - a list cannot.
